memory_scope: GNU time maximum resident set size of complete worker, including both stream checkers, all stages, default-API replays, semantic and mutation checks, hashing, artifacts and IO; not isolated per-phase or per-checker memory
phase_scope: one timed invocation per named stage; 13 stages include overlapping encoding/layout/checking comparisons; sum only the original eight production intervals for a production subtotal
replay_scope: source identities plus retained executable seed and persisted-input consumer; not a Lean/compiler rebuild
sampling: fresh full worker process; fixed sizes ascending, shared then graph; one sample per stage per process
source_state: base commit plus the complete uncommitted files in source.tar.gz; final performance prose is added later
